name: reconcile_history

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd(); r=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text()); terms=[str(x) for x in r['ids']]+[x['source_url'].split('/')[-1] for x in r['rows']]
allow=json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); inventory=[]; matches=[]
for s,digest in allow.items():
 if any(x in s.lower() for x in ['r423','r424','r395','code-loop','code_loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','bunkbed','hat-','hat_']):continue
 p=Path(s); b=p.read_bytes(); actual=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(); assert actual==digest,(s,actual)
 text=b.decode(); hits=[t for t in terms if re.search(r'(?<![0-9])'+re.escape(t)+r'(?![0-9])',text)]
 inventory.append({'path':s,'sha256':actual,'hits':hits})
 if hits: matches.append({'path':s,'hits':hits,'body':text});print('MATCH',s,text)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'history-reconciliation.json'],input=json.dumps({'checked':inventory,'matches':matches},indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
d=json.loads(Path('inherited-denials.json').read_text());print('DENIED KEYS',d['blocked_keys']);print('DENIED ARTIFACTS',d['blocked_artifacts']);print('SCOPES',[(x.get('url'),x.get('scope',x.get('artifact_scope',''))) for x in d.get('events',d.get('evidence',[]))] if isinstance(d.get('events',d.get('evidence',[])),list) else list(d));print('CHECKED',len(inventory),'MATCHES',len(matches))
